metadata.description: GAME MODE for Claude Code: 21 mods for an 8-bit look where every piece does a job (HUD, battle log, three guards, save point and title screen, sound cues, stance, casting, clear time, party, quest, minimap, hint, map, spell check, answer memory, hedge mark, item get, equip, achievements)

plugins.name: game-hud
plugins.description: 8-bit HUD window above the prompt: LV/EXP, HP = context left, MP = plan usage left, G = session cost, a status row (HP LOW!, REST, SAVED, LEVEL UP!) with rest and save buttons

plugins.name: game-battle-log
plugins.description: Tool rows as an 8-bit battle log: a TURN header on each turn's first row, HIT, CRIT with +added −removed lines, MISS with the lines that say what failed, COMBO ×n and BREAK, each guard's own verdict (TRAP!, BARRIER!, LOOP!), and SUMMON on the run-in-background pill

plugins.name: game-trap-guard
plugins.description: Stops tool calls that would leak a secret: literal keys in commands or source files, cat .env / echo $API_KEY, reading key files into the conversation

plugins.name: game-barrier
plugins.description: Stops irreversible calls: force-push to main, reset --hard, rm -r outside the project, publishing, DROP TABLE, and file edits outside the project

plugins.name: game-loop-breaker
plugins.description: Stops the same call failing the same way again and again: warns at LOOP 2/3, blocks the next identical run once sealed, lifts after a change or a new message

plugins.name: game-save-point
plugins.description: /save writes an 8-bit save screen (cleared, quest log, decisions, inventory, a password with the resume prompt copied); /load <password>; a title screen with CONTINUE, NEW GAME and LOAD when a session starts in a folder with saves

plugins.name: game-earcons
plugins.description: 8-bit sound cues on macOS, Windows and Linux: a permission prompt or question waiting on you, a long turn finished, an error, a guard refusing a call, a save

plugins.name: game-stance
plugins.description: The permission mode as a colored badge at the right of the prompt footer: 기본, 자동 승인, 계획, 자동 판정, 우회, 묻지 않음; follows shift+tab

plugins.name: game-casting
plugins.description: The spinner while a turn runs: CASTING · what runs now · 행동 n · G +the turn's cost so far, with the engine's own time and tokens after it

plugins.name: game-clear-time
plugins.description: A turn ends with CLEAR m:ss · 행동 n · 이번 턴 ₩x · 평소보다 ±m:ss, against the median of the project's last 20 turns

plugins.name: game-party
plugins.description: /party: each subagent of the session with ACTIVE, CLEAR or FAIL, a bar of its tool calls and its job; opens by itself when one starts on a wide terminal

plugins.name: game-quest
plugins.description: /quest: the task list as a quest log (✓ done, ▶ in progress, · to do, the last one the BOSS), kept across /compact and into the next session in the same project

plugins.name: game-minimap
plugins.description: /minimap: a grid of the project's files — edited, read, unexplored — with read counts on files read 3+ times and the most re-read file named

plugins.name: game-hint
plugins.description: The hint line under the prompt adds what to press now: ESC 후퇴 while working, /compact 휴식 at low HP, 오류부터 읽기 after repeated failures, /save 세이브 when a save is due

plugins.name: game-map
plugins.description: A status line with the branch and the play time: MAP <branch> · 플레이 h:mm, with ⚠ on a protected branch such as main

plugins.name: game-spell-check
plugins.description: Vague words (적당히, 알아서, 대충 …) underlined while you type and secrets in red; a vague prompt with no done condition asks Claude to state one first; your messages drawn as P1 with the done condition

plugins.name: game-answer-memory
plugins.description: When Claude asks a question it asked before in this project, the option you chose last time is marked ★ 지난번 선택

plugins.name: game-hedge-mark
plugins.description: Claude's replies in a window headed CLAUDE; sentences that guess (아마, 추정, probably, might …) marked [?], with a footer counting them

plugins.name: game-item-get
plugins.description: A file Claude creates shows ITEM GET! <path>; /inventory lists the files created and changed this session with their line counts

plugins.name: game-equip
plugins.description: The model as equipment: EQUIP 모델 <model> 장착 · 교체는 /model at the start, in place of the model notice, and again when the model changes

plugins.name: game-achievement
plugins.description: ★ ACHIEVEMENT toasts for milestones: first save, 10 safe commits, a comeback, a 10-call combo, a rest before HP 10%; /achievements lists them
